scope: Six author-suggested references retained because they support existing prose. Four requiring new prose were removed. Original source checks are targeted checks, not experiment reproduction.

records.title: EvolveNav: Proactive Preflection and Self-Evolving Memory for Zero-Shot Object Goal Navigation
records.supported_claim: Extracts navigation rules from completed episodes and retrieves them in later episodes.
records.interpretation_limit: Rule memory changes do not establish improvement of the memory-update algorithm.

records.title: Genesis: Evolving Attack Strategies for LLM Web Agent Red-Teaming
records.supported_claim: Summarizes attack logs into reusable textual or coded strategies and saves them for later attacks.
records.interpretation_limit: The improving system is the attacker. This is not evidence that the attacked web agent becomes safer. Distinct from the architecture method Genesys.

records.title: Enhancing Jailbreak Attacks on LLMs via Persona Prompts
records.supported_claim: Language models carry out crossover and mutation of candidate persona prompts.
records.interpretation_limit: Supports model-assisted prompt revision, not improved mutation rules or better safety of the target LLM.

records.title: LLM-Based Agent Society Investigation: Collaboration and Confrontation in Avalon Gameplay
records.supported_claim: Produces role-level suggestions for future games and incorporates them into playing strategies.
records.interpretation_limit: Supports reuse beyond the current response. Does not show improvement of the strategy-update procedure.

records.title: MultiMind: Enhancing Werewolf Agents with Multimodal Reasoning and Theory of Mind
records.supported_claim: LLM agents generate self-play games and reported beliefs to train a separate theory-of-mind model.
records.interpretation_limit: Supports a learner distinct from the experience providers. Checked against the locally archived ACM proceedings PDF.

records.title: DVM: Towards Controllable LLM Agents in Social Deduction Games
records.supported_claim: Self-play provides experience for training the Predictor and Decider after supervised training.
records.interpretation_limit: Supports interactive training experience, not a learned or changing reward-design procedure. Method checked against author arXiv version; conference metadata from publisher-deposited Crossref record.
